overview.label: THE PREMISE
overview.logline: In a future of extraordinary abundance, a famous scientist entrusts the defense of human sovereignty to her gifted daughter, whose unlikely bond with an SI humanoid carries her from an annual invention tournament into a struggle for humanity’s survival.

acts.title: Act I
paragraphs: In 2060, humanity has built a world of astonishing beauty. Invention is a cultural obsession. Skye helped bring this into existence through an invention called the Post Selection Generator that can generate enormous amounts of energy and a framework for collective intelligence known as The Commons. Now she sees those achievements at risk of becoming instruments of control. Her employer, Richard, believes something this powerful must be centralized. As their shared legacy becomes a battleground, Skye must decide how much she is willing to risk to protect the future she helped create.

Her daughter Eve is a young scientist and wants a life that belongs to her. Instead, she inherits her mother’s unfinished work and a robot named Robot, who challenges her assumptions about both her place in the world and his. An immense tournament promises to crown the next generation of inventors, drawing Eve toward a spectacle she resents but cannot entirely resist. Beyond the city, a sacred forest conceals a dangerous secret. Skye has given her daughter more than a scientific problem. She has entrusted her with defending human freedom.

acts.title: Act II
paragraphs: Eve enters a tournament where genius is spectacle and every mistake becomes public entertainment. The reigning champion, Phoenix, is a celebrated socialite whose brilliance has become an empire of influence. Eve struggles to distinguish her own ambitions from the expectations surrounding her mother’s name. As admiration turns to accusation and rivalries distract her from the larger stakes, Robot becomes her most dependable collaborator. Her imagination, combined with his vast database, takes them far beyond what either could accomplish alone.

Meanwhile, Skye is haunted by visions of ruin as Richard moves closer to a future governed by his will. Their confrontation exposes betrayals that reach deep into both their families. Eve fights her way to the tournament final, only to lose to Phoenix. The recognition she hoped would prove her worth slips away—and what she discovers afterward makes that defeat seem terrifyingly small. The living energy source Richard has imprisoned in his laboratory is connected to a larger presence preparing to destroy the Post Selection Generators on which civilization depends. Eve returns to forbidden territory seeking an answer, while Skye becomes trapped by a villain prepared to destroy what he cannot control.

acts.title: Act III
paragraphs: Answering Skye’s distress call, Jason—her husband and Eve’s father—infiltrates Richard’s laboratory undetected. The attack on the Post Selection Generators is underway. Deep in the forest, Eve confronts the scale of humanity’s mistake. Surrounded by creatures whose mature forms dwarf anything she imagined, at the brink of collapse, Eve draws on everything she and Robot have learned and turns to the world for help. She goes live, letting everyone witness what is at stake. Across the planet, people and their SI partners begin contributing in their own ways. Human creativity, translated by SI through The Commons, becomes a source of power sustained by sovereign difference. The independence Richard regards as civilization’s weakness becomes the condition of its survival.

Even as the old energy systems falter and Jason discovers the truth about Skye and Richard’s past, he and Skye must fight to keep humanity alive long enough for the transformation to take hold. Skye’s final confrontation with Richard ends in his death. Through the participation of billions, humanity creates an energy system that leaves the creatures no central weakness to exploit. They retreat and amid the celebration, Eve’s boyfriend, Lucas, learns that her mother has killed his father. Having helped her save humanity, he stands beside her, concealing the grief that will grow into the next threat to everything they have built.
